list.railTip: Flows automate replies the moment a customer messages a connected number. Start from a Library preset or build your own — every active flow triggers across all paired devices.
list.tip: Start with a Welcome flow first — it converts ~3× better than re-engagement, and you'll learn what your audience replies to.
list.empty: No flows match the current filters. Try clearing filters or create your first automated flow.

help.label: Help · {n}
help.a1: A sequence of messages, waits, and decision branches that starts from a trigger like signup, cart abandonment, or purchase completion.
help.q2: How do I optimize my flows?
help.a2: Keep the opening step short, branch by intent early, and measure drop-off at each node so you know where conversion slips.
help.q3: Which flows should I launch first?
help.a3: For most stores: welcome → cart recovery → post-purchase review. That covers acquisition, conversion, and retention with minimum overhead.

file.saveAsPropertyHelp: Store the customer's upload in a contact property
file.propertyHint: The link to the received file is written to this property of the contact.
file.variableHint: The link to the received file is stored here (for example {file}) and can be used later in a Send media node. Also saved: {kind}, {name}, {mime}, {caption} and {status}.
file.retriesHint: How many times the customer may try again after a wrong reply (plain text, or a file type that is not allowed). 0 gives up on the first wrong reply.
file.wrongReplyHint: Sent when the customer replies with text or a file that is not allowed, while retries are left.
file.skipHint: When the customer sends exactly this word, the flow moves on with an empty answer. Leave empty for no skip.
file.onFailContinue: Continue the flow without a file
file.timeoutHint: 0 uses the flow's usual idle limit. When the wait runs out the flow ends, like the Ask question node.
file.outputHint: One output: it fires once a file is received (or when the retries are used up and you chose to continue).

extensions.empty: Select nothing to accept any file.

location.interactiveHint: On the WhatsApp Cloud API the prompt carries a button that opens the location picker. Other channels, or when this is off, get plain text: write the instruction in the question.
location.variableHint: The Google Maps link is stored here (for example {loc}). Also saved: {latitude}, {longitude}, {name}, {address}, {link} and {status}.
location.retriesHint: How many times the customer may try again after a wrong reply (anything but a shared location). 0 gives up on the first wrong reply.
location.wrongReplyHint: Sent when the customer replies with text or a file while retries are left.
location.skipHint: When the customer sends exactly this word, the flow moves on with an empty answer. Leave empty for no skip.
location.onFailContinue: Continue the flow without a location
location.timeoutHint: 0 uses the flow's usual idle limit. When the wait runs out the flow ends, like the Ask question node.
location.outputHint: One output: it fires once a location is received (or when the retries are used up and you chose to continue).
